package: DEV-SEQ-1: per-sequence decision and execution, grouped failures, one Slow knowledge update, development level
question: does the Harness observe, decide and execute per sequence, and does one validated update to the shared guidance change what the next batch of Fast does

registered_plan.decision_population_rule: the first 10 eval series of the block in roster order

admission_note: installed for continuity with the previous packages; with a one-series decision population strict and bounded_risk_v1 decide identically, because a single series cannot be both aggregate-positive and materially harmed

units.gate_note: recorded, not acted on: this package writes knowledge only at the batch boundary, so no unit gate activates anything

cache.scope_is_not_in_the_key: re-masking is the point; both models are Scope-independent and each series' loss depends only on its own prediction row

comparability.why: one Task x Consumer x metric key and one domain namespace, so a difference between two members is a difference in what was done, not in what was being asked

contrast_cases.kept_because: a group without its matched successes can only say what failed, never what still works

ungrouped_failures.why: too little evidence to form a group; kept as an Episode

grouping.grouping_key: full typed workflow fingerprint x response sign, then comparability, symptom, parameter variants and the visible pattern spread as recorded evidence

boundary.why_this_group: the largest group by member count, tie broken by group id; not chosen on any gain

card.what_happened: 7 per-sequence decisions ran outlier_mad and came out NEGATIVE on their own evaluated sequence.  Each decision was taken for one sequence from that sequence's own visible context; they are grouped here because the typed workflow and the response sign match, not because they merely both failed.

applicability_grammar.task_kind_is_special: {"feature": "task_kind", "op": "==", "value": "forecast"} -- an eligibility gate, not a condition on its own

card.what_you_may_write: Exactly one new capability entry whose body is guidance in prose: what to observe, how to construct candidates, and under which condition the guidance applies.  It must NOT contain the string 'Frozen program steps:' and must not claim candidate-supply authority: one replacement program handed to the whole group is the thing this boundary exists to avoid.  Fast will read the body and generate its own program for each sequence separately.  State the condition in observable_applicability over the deployment-visible features above; a condition that matches every sequence is not a condition.

how_to_fill_the_manifest.new_value.skill_id: a new lowercase id, not one already in existing_entry_inventory
how_to_fill_the_manifest.predicted_agent_behavior_change: exactly ['retrieve_skill:<your new_value.skill_id>'] -- the predicate vocabulary is closed and this is the only member that fits a guidance entry
how_to_fill_the_manifest.observable_applicability: the condition, written in applicability_grammar's closed leaf form over the features shown per sequence above; the same object goes in both edit_manifest.observable_applicability and new_value.observable_applicability

card.you_may_offer_a_provisional_explanation: A tentative account is acceptable and expected; you are not required to prove a unique cause first.  Do not force the answer into 'narrow the Scope' if the evidence does not point there.

proposal.retry_rule: only a protocol/schema fault is retried, and at most once; an abstention and a content refusal both stand

followup.why: no qualifying update formed, so the two arms would be the same library and the comparison would measure nothing about knowledge

cost.counting: every physical Consumer fit, including those spent inside a call that then raised; nothing carried over

refusals.a_frozen_program_body_is_refused: a frozen program in the body would make this one replacement program for the whole group; guidance only
refusals.candidate_supply_authority_is_refused: candidate-supply authority is not granted here
refusals.a_serving_scope_on_guidance_is_refused: the execution boundary is the sequence the decision belongs to; a serving scope on a guidance card would re-broadcast it

checks.what_the_baseline_is: the two working-tree edits that predate this package (2026-09-05); anything else means a core file was touched

what_this_is_not: development level: five already-exposed course units, ten sequences each, one course.  Not a generalisation claim, not an A5 result, and no significance is claimed.  The readings are on a per-sequence denominator and are not comparable to the cohort-broadcast numbers of DEV-AUTO-1/2/3 or DEV-KNOW-1.
